meta.title: 3D Print Workbench
meta.description: Parametric OpenSCAD modeling, mesh QA, slicer interop, a Blender bridge, and a calibration test-body library — one built-in toolchain.

tools.doctor: Probe OpenSCAD / Blender / slicer installs and report what is missing
tools.setup: Install OpenSCAD automatically (source auto-selected: winget → upstream → mirror)
tools.render: Render .scad to STL / 3MF / PNG with parameter overrides and camera
tools.check: Mesh QA: watertightness, volume, bounds, real overhang, bed fit
tools.parts: Calibration test-body library: list, export, generate
tools.slice: Detect installed slicers, slice from the CLI or open the GUI
tools.blender: Blender bridge: open, export GLB, headless scripted edits
tools.selftest: Built-in regression run over the standard test bodies
